meta.summary: Trello marketing and template pages: sign-up forms, hero video, covers, stats
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, headless Chrome (iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA): trello.com (home) and trello.com/templates. A public board was not loaded (the capture timed out), and the signed-in app (boards, lists, cards) needs an account and was not seen.

What the logged-out site shows: a marketing home page (hero video, sign-up forms, carousels, blog cards) and a template gallery. Classes are hashed, so selectors use data-testid values, which are stable across both layouts.

- **Cookie banners**: kept the generic OneTrust rule and added the Trello notice bar div[data-testid=cookies-consent-banner] (1 on /templates, LIVE). On the home page only the OneTrust root exists, hidden.
- **Sign-up forms**: form[data-testid=ui-email-signup-form] 2 on home (LIVE).
- **Promo buttons**: a[data-testid=ui-nav-banner-button] 7 on home, including copies in the hidden mega-menu (LIVE).
- **Hero video**: video[data-testid=ui-video] 1 and span[data-testid=ui-modal-trigger] 1 (LIVE).
- **Template covers** (Show/Blur/Hide): the first div of each tile, 24 on /templates (LIVE). Blur is a css rule and Hide a hide rule, each tagged with its choice.
- **Template stats**: the Copies and Views spans, matched through their CopyIcon and SubscribeIcon children, 24 each (LIVE). The numbers are inside those spans.
- **Carousels and blog teasers**: data-testid carousel 3, list-carousel 1, ui-blog-article 2 on home (LIVE).

Not verified: the ad rule (the only match was one doubleclick.net iframe on the mobile home page, probably a tracking frame; no visible ad slot was seen), the app-banner rule (no Smart App Banner seen), logged-in views, and other languages. Fixtures real.html, real-templates.html and the desktop-real* pair are structure captures of the live DOM with text removed; synthetic.html still covers the generic rules.
